component.summary: AI code editor that works offline

description.p: ZeroEgress has chat, an agent mode, quick edit and autocomplete, and talks only to model servers you run yourself (Ollama, vLLM or LM Studio, on your machine or your own network). It connects to loopback and to the servers you configure, and nothing else. Telemetry, auto-update, the online extension marketplace and cloud sign-in are removed.
